reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first query helper and the existing upgradingId parameter for the re-link exemption; there was no pre-existing link-guard to reuse.

duplication.why: The duplicate-link rule is written once in assertBankAccountNotLinked; only a three-line call with the provider literal is repeated in each of the five already-copied link functions.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers that use it; link.ts, which already holds shared linking helpers like findOrCreateBank, would have been an equally natural home.

scope.why: Only adds the guard and its five call sites, nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: A single, clearly named guard called first in each provider path is easy to own; the provider string is repeated per call as it already is in each function, so a new provider must remember to add the call.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; all five link paths call the new guard.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic beyond the per-provider call.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called at the top of linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
